verified_facts.text: The resort sits on 120 acres of wooded land just outside Lenox, Massachusetts.

verified_facts.text: The grounds are anchored by Bellefontaine Mansion, built in 1897.

verified_facts.excerpt: a 1897 estate inspired by the Petit Trianon at Versailles that later served as a Jesuit seminary

verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy meals featuring our nutritious and comforting take on Mediterranean classics. Service is fast causal, allowing for an expedited dining experience, while enjoying the beautiful view of the great lawn.

verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal, regional dishes are prepared using fresh, wholesome ingredients free of additives and unhealthy extras. Vegan and gluten-free options available.
